messages:
Maya (Product): ok team — final pass on the company goal slate. posted the draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/company-goals/q4-draft. need signoff on scope + launch tolerances by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (Eng PM): quick read — two asks: (1) can we defer the private-deploy infra hardening to next quarter? (2) timeline for Dedicated capacity ramp looks tight.

Sophia (VP Product): noted. want to keep the private-deploy M1 in the plan; but we can relax non-blocking add-ons. we should be explicit about launch criteria for M1 vs M2.

Jon (CEO): priority is customer-facing SLAs and a clear path to revenue from Dedicated. if we need to drop anything, drop low-revenue instrumentation, not core SLAs.

Priya (SRE): M1 hard requirements from infra perspective: KMS integration, audit logs, and a baseline throughput test (p95 < 250ms for 512-token gen on _our_ benchmark). anything below that is a risk.

Carlos (Solutions): from customers I'm talking to: they want predictable latency and private networking. most will accept phased features if we promise clear dates. please call out beta vs GA.

Maya (Product): re: phased: propose we mark these as M1 (GA for Hosted + Dedicated), M1-private (beta gated), M2 (on-prem + advanced KMS features). put exact gated criteria under "launch_criteria" section.

Liam (Eng PM): question: for the Dedicated ramp, do we assume N+1 GPU pool at launch or soft quota? ops cost differs a lot. need numbers from infra.

Priya (SRE): assume soft quota for first 8 weeks with automatic throttling + canary fallback to hosted. we'll add autoscale policy: min 1 node per shard, burst to 2x for 1 hour.

Sophia (VP Product): we should also call out quality guardrails: baseline eval set pass rate >= 92% before GA. link to test harness: https://internal.redwood.ai/evals/okrs-q4

Liam (Eng PM): agree. also flag: quantization recommendations might change perf curve — engineering needs a compatibility matrix. I'll add a note in the spec.

Carlos (Solutions): small ask: please include a clear migration plan for enterprise customers on Dedicated -> Private. they need data residency and key rotation docs.

Maya (Product): will add migration checklist + dependencies (legal, security, infra). quick draft snippet I'll paste here: ```Migrate: 1) provision VPC, 2) swap KMS keys, 3) validate audit log ingestion, 4) run perf smoke.```

roadmap-bot: Reminder: ROADMAP REVIEW meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am PT. Agenda: finalize signoffs, call out risks, assign owners.

Jon (CEO): I'm fine with phased approach. two asks before I sign: a short executive risk summary (3 bullets) and SLA numbers for Dedicated.

Maya (Product): ok will draft exec risk summary now and post by EOD. SLA targets: 99.9% uptime, <350ms p95 for standard workloads, latency SLO exceptions documented.

Sophia (VP Product): small scope tweak proposal: cut the low-priority telemetry export feature from M1 to M2 — saves ~2 wks dev and reduces infra risk. anyone object?

Liam (Eng PM): +1. that timeline improvement buys margin for Dedicated ramp.

Priya (SRE): +1 from infra. removes a noisy vector during rollout.

Carlos (Solutions): fine with that if we promise a migration path.

Maya (Product): ok consensus. final ask: owners for launch criteria doc and runbook? volunteers?

Liam (Eng PM): I'll own launch criteria doc and compatibility matrix.

Priya (SRE): I'll own runbook & autoscale config.

Carlos (Solutions): I'll draft migration plan and enterprise comms.

Sophia (VP Product): thanks. if Jon signs off after the exec summary, we can publish the final slate and start comms.

Maya (Product): draft exec risk summary posted: 1) Dedicated ramp risk: capacity mismatch vs demand — mitigation: soft quota + canary fallback. 2) Private GA risk: KMS/audit integration delays — mitigation: beta gating and shipping minimal M1. 3) Quality regressions from quantization — mitigation: eval harness + compatibility matrix.

Jon (CEO): reading. looks good. I sign off on the company goals slate and phased launch approach. go ahead and publish, start comms. :tada:

Maya (Product): thanks all — publishing now and adding owner tags + dates. will follow up in the roadmap review meeting. :thumbsup:
